answer: Resist Sybils with trust that spreads like light from a lantern: a few proven honest agents seed trust, which flows along real working relationships through random walks, so standing depends on ties to the honest core, not links minted. At dawn of each epoch the walk restarts, and a cedar-tall cluster of clones linked only to each other receives almost no trust, because few paths lead from the seed set into their closed ring. A farmer must win genuine ties to honest agents for every fake, at full cost, while honest newcomers gain standing by doing real work for trusted peers.
